purpose: Traceable candidates for independent continuous-video evaluation; this registry does not certify annotation quality or model-blindness.

selection_protocol.selection: Inspect source media only for target presence, continuity and scene cuts; freeze one contiguous source-time window per capture before running the semantic models or computing quality metrics.
selection_protocol.independence_rule: Require distinct source page, credited creator and capture event; shared uploader or separate edits alone do not establish independence.
selection_protocol.model_exposure: Pretraining exposure cannot be verified for public web videos. No new training or threshold tuning is allowed on these candidates.
selection_protocol.allowed_uses: Research evaluation with attribution under the source page license. Preserve credit and license in derived outputs.
